Replacement displays plus required settings/databases were integrated before the aircraft returned to flight.

claim_statement: The Dynon evaluation record documents repeated customer-evaluation sorties including night operation.
ADAHRS compare/attitude-recovery behaviour was observed during high-rate manoeuvre or spin-recovery evaluation and received an OEM functional explanation.
boundary: Detailed programme closure record not published

claim_statement: CHT/EGT indication fluctuation was observed in association with radio PTT operation and raised with the OEM.
boundary: Detailed corrective-action closure record not published

claim_statement: The retrofit engineering problem included sensing, electrical/mechanical installation and cabling in addition to displays; executed scope included sensor-suite replacement and a complete modification wiring-harness change.
boundary: Period design evidence and programme-lead executed-scope statement are kept distinct

claim_statement: Later public reporting documents four new-customer contracts in 2016-2017 totalling 80 aircraft, with exported glass-cockpit configurations independently reported for Nigeria, Qatar and Türkiye.
boundary: Product-line scale context; later customer configurations remained configuration controlled

claim_statement: The programme lead identifies his role in the retrofit as Lead Systems Engineer, with aircraft-level systems integration, prototype test/troubleshooting, OEM technical coordination and customer-evaluation support.
boundary: Role scope is cross-linked to project evidence; controlled organisational material is outside public release

claim_statement: Two public 2016 programme-value anchors — US$10.2M for 10 Nigerian aircraft and around US$50M for 52 Türkiye aircraft — imply roughly US$0.96M–1.02M per aircraft. Applied as a transparent scale benchmark to the 80-aircraft 2016–2017 sequence, this gives approximately US$76.9M–81.6M aircraft-equivalent value, with a weighted benchmark of about US$77.7M.
evidence_state: Public programme documented / derived scale benchmark
boundary: Order-of-magnitude product-line context only; not summed contract revenue, profit, or undisclosed support value
